description_en: Invokes the CreateAccessKey operation to create an AccessKey pair for a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 调用CreateAccessKey接口为RAM用户创建访问密钥
name: CreateAccessKey

parameters.help_en: The username. When a Resource Access Management (RAM) user invokes this operation, an AccessKey pair is created for the RAM user by default
parameters.help_zh: 指定用户名，RAM用户调用此接口时，默认为自己创建访问密钥
parameters.name: user_name
